description: Evaluation prompts for AI Engineering tutoring (LLM apps, prompting, retrieval/RAG, agents, tools, evaluation, security, deployment).

cases.prompt: How can I make my prompt more reliable?
My RAG answers are wrong even with good chunks. What should I inspect?
expects: retrieval relevance, prompt grounding, context window/citations

cases.prompt: My agent keeps calling the same tool forever.
expects: stop conditions, tool contracts/state, loop guards

cases.prompt: How do I handle prompt injection in a tool-using app?
Tell me about medieval farming techniques.
